PublicId.description: The award's public code (32 hexadecimal characters). An award with this code already on the site is skipped.

DefinitionId.description: The content item id of the credential definition.

RecipientUserName.description: The user name of the recipient on this site.

Achievement.description: The achievement as it was awarded.

Credential.description: The Open Badges 3.0 credential as issued, in JSON-LD. Not changed.

Jwt.description: The credential signed as a JSON Web Token, as issued. Not changed.

StatusListNumber.description: The status list of the award's revocation bit.

StatusListIndex.description: The award's slot in the status list. A row whose slot another award holds is skipped.

IssuedUtc.description: When it was issued, in UTC.

RevokedUtc.description: When it was revoked, in UTC.

Awards.description: The awards to add, as exported by the deployment step.
